materials.name: gear
materials.wears: the belt's leather: a broad flat band of thick leather as wide as a hand is across three fingers, with one keeper loop, and two chunky closed pouches, one on each hip. Each pouch is a simple rounded box with a flap lid, sewn flat against the outside of the band. Band, loop and pouches are all tan.

materials.name: buckles
materials.look: DARK STEEL GREY metal, plain dull gunmetal (hex #5F646C)
materials.wears: the metal fittings: the heavy square buckle at the middle of the front, one solid frame two fingers wider than the band, and the round stud on each pouch's flap. All of them grey steel.

prompt:
Product image of one heavy leather utility belt for a near-future city dweller, shown by itself: a belt buckled closed into a ring, floating in the air with nobody wearing it. The image holds the belt alone on a plain white background.

Shape, the most important thing in this image: the belt is a closed, level, oval hoop, as if buckled round an invisible person's waist. The hoop is empty: through it the plain white background shows, and the inner face of the far side of the band is visible above the near side. The band is the same height all the way round and keeps level, like a ring lying flat. The belt is one single band that goes round exactly once, one ring with one buckle, and the tip of the band ends just past the buckle, held flat against the band by one keeper loop. Under the band the two pouches hang and, between them, there is only white background.

{materials}
The grey steel buckle and studs are clearly greyer and darker than the tan leather. Every part of the belt is one of these two colours.

Everything on the belt is attached flat to the outside of the band and stays close to it, and the inside of the hoop is smooth and empty.

Camera: a three-quarter view. The hoop is turned so that the camera looks at it from between its front and one hip, and from a little above, looking down by about 25 degrees, long lens with almost no perspective. On the near side of the hoop, facing the camera, are the buckle, right of the middle of the image, and one pouch, left of the middle, its whole broad face in plain view. The other pouch is on the far side.

Smooth clean surfaces like a painted sculpt: plain colour on every part, clean and new, thick smooth leather, simple chunky shapes, clean edges between parts.

Soft even studio lighting with gentle shading that shows the forms, the whole belt in frame with margin on all sides, plain white background.
